steps.js: (() => { window.__clicks=[]; const rec=(e)=>{ if(window.__clicks.length<6) window.__clicks.push({type:e.type,x:Math.round(e.clientX),y:Math.round(e.clientY),target:(e.target.tagName||'')+':'+(e.target.className||'').toString().slice(0,40)}); }; for(const t of ['pointerdown','mousedown','click']) document.addEventListener(t, rec, true); return 'listeners-on'; })()
steps.desc: document 级捕获监听记录真实点击坐标
